selection_criterion: highest mean 5-fold development CV macro F1
evaluation_limit: The same fixed test images were evaluated in earlier project iterations; results are a reused holdout, not a new blind benchmark.
cv_limit: The tuning search reuses the same CV folds. Its best CV score is selection-biased; the search is not nested CV.
cv_standard_deviation: sample standard deviation (ddof=1); GridSearchCV reports population std
timing_note: Fit and prediction times exclude feature extraction. CV score_time includes all scoring metrics and is not inference-only latency.
